summary: A 1800 x 2001 x 581 mm wardrobe with two full-height side compartments, a middle compartment with a door over three drawers, and anti-tip wall fixing.
tools: Drill (wall fixing only, not for screwing)
unclear: Exact position and role of rails 9 and 10 in the drawer frame (steps 9-12) is partly guessed; in 3D they are modelled lying flat at the front in the gaps between the drawer boxes so they do not clash with the drawers.
Orientation of front strips 11R/22L (70 mm face toward front assumed).
Step 38: manual shows D x6 for 3 drawers, modelled as 1 connector screw per drawer side.
Drawer bottom 19 (498 mm) is wider than the 489 mm gap between the drawer sides because it runs in grooves; grooves are not modelled, so in 3D the bottom is shown just under the side edges.
The whole cabinet stands about 5 mm above the floor in 3D: sides 1980 + top 16 = 1996 mm, the printed height is 2001 mm, so the glide nails G account for the 5 mm. This is left as is.
Plate R is labelled 22x10x3 mm on the parts page but 23x13x3 mm in step 27.
Use of item K (nail holder) is only inferred from step 27 drawing.
Shelf heights and back panel exact positions are estimated; shelves are adjustable.
Cam locks, cam screws, dowels and shelf pins are not individually placed in 3D.
Middle door hinge positions shown for option L only.

6.look: 1766x561, slightly smaller than the top, with large holes near the ends.

8.name: Fixed shelf above drawers
8.look: 578x544, deeper than shelf 7, with two cam holes.

15.name: Drawer front
15.look: 582x205 with hole rows at both ends.

23.name: Hinge strip
23.look: Narrow strip 1178x44 with groups of holes.

1L.look: Tallest board (1980 mm). Shelf-pin hole rows, marked L.

2R.name: Right side
2R.look: Mirror of 1L, marked R, 1980 mm long.

3R.name: Right divider
3R.look: 1876 mm long, 544 wide, two shelf-pin rows, marked 3R.

D.name: Connector screw 7x50
D.look: Thick screw with hex socket head

steps.title: Dowels in shelf 8
steps.text: Tap 8 dowels into the edge holes of fixed shelf 8. Put dowels only in the small edge holes, not the cam holes.
steps.tip: Do not tap dowels into the round cam-lock holes.

steps.title: Dowels in divider 3R
steps.text: Lay divider 3R flat and tap 7 dowels into its edge holes.

steps.title: Join shelf 8 to divider 3R
steps.text: Push shelf 8 onto the dowels of 3R. Screw it tight with 2 connector screws D through 3R using hex key Q.
steps.tip: Screw D in straight and stop when the head is flush, not sunk deeper.

steps.title: Dowels in divider 21L
steps.text: Lay divider 21L flat and tap 7 dowels into its edge holes.

steps.title: Fit divider 21L
steps.text: Push 21L onto the other end of shelf 8 and fix it with 2 connector screws D using the hex key.
steps.tip: Make sure the shelf-pin rows of both dividers face the same way.

steps.title: Prepare first runner panel
steps.text: On one panel 4, tap in 6 dowels, screw in 2 cam screws F, and screw on 3 runners CL with 4 screws C each. The runner wheel end goes to the front.
steps.tip: Use the left runners CL on this panel and the right runners CR on the other.

steps.title: Prepare second runner panel
steps.text: On the other panel 4, tap in 6 dowels, screw in 2 cam screws F, and screw on 3 runners CR with 4 screws C each.

steps.title: Dowels in rails 10
steps.text: Tap 2 dowels into the ends of each of the two thick rails 10 (4 in total).

steps.title: Build the drawer frame
steps.text: Fit the two rails 10 between the two panels 4 onto the cam screws. Push 4 cam locks E into the rails and turn them to lock.
steps.tip: Turn the cam locks only after the panels are fully pushed onto the cam screws.

steps.title: Slide in the drawer frame
steps.text: Slide the drawer frame between the dividers under shelf 8, onto the dowels. Check the runner wheel ends are at the front.

steps.title: Cam screws in rail 9
steps.text: Screw 2 cam screws F into rail 9.

steps.title: Fit rail 9
steps.text: Lower rail 9 into place between the runner panels, flush with the front edge. Lock it with 2 cam locks E.
steps.tip: Keep the rail flush with the edge as shown in the warning detail.

steps.title: Prepare front strips
steps.text: Tap 4 dowels into the ends of each front strip 22L and 11R, and screw 3 cam screws F into each.

steps.title: Fit the front strips
steps.text: Place 22L on the front edge of divider 21L and 11R on the front edge of 3R. Lock each with 3 cam locks E.
steps.tip: Do not swap 22L and 11R.

steps.title: Prepare plinth and bottom
steps.text: Tap 4 dowels into the ends of plinth 12 and hammer in 2 glides G, each 590 mm from an end, centred on the edge. Tap 6 dowels into the bottom 6.
steps.tip: Centre the glides on the plinth edge.

steps.title: Join plinth to bottom
steps.text: Fix plinth 12 to the bottom 6 with 2 connector screws D.

steps.title: Fit the bottom
steps.text: Fit the bottom with plinth onto the ends of the dividers and fix it with 4 connector screws D.
steps.tip: The plinth goes at the front, on the same side as the front strips.

steps.title: Cam screws in left side
steps.text: Screw 2 cam screws F into the lower end of left side 1L.

steps.title: Dowels and glides on left side
steps.text: Tap 2 dowels into the top edge of 1L. Hammer 2 glides G into the bottom edge, 50 mm from front and back, centred.

steps.title: Fit the left side
steps.text: Push 1L onto the bottom and lock it with 2 cam locks E.

steps.title: Prepare the right side
steps.text: On right side 2R tap in 2 dowels at the top, screw in 2 cam screws F, and hammer in 2 glides G 50 mm from the edges.

steps.title: Fit the right side
steps.text: Push 2R onto the bottom and lock it with 2 cam locks E.

steps.title: Cam screws in the top
steps.text: Screw 8 cam screws F into the underside of top 5.

steps.title: Anti-tip brackets on top
steps.text: Screw 2 brackets P to the back edge of the top with 2 screws L each. Tighten only about 80% for now.
steps.tip: Use the short screws L here, not the long M screws.

steps.title: Fit the top
steps.text: Place the top on the sides and dividers and lock it with 8 cam locks E.

steps.title: Stand up and mark backs
steps.text: Stand the wardrobe up and lay the three back panels 20 on the back. Mark with a pencil the line of shelf 8 on the back panels.
steps.tip: Check the ceiling is over 215 cm before tipping it up.
steps.warn: Two people needed to raise the wardrobe.

steps.title: Square up and nail the backs
steps.text: Measure both diagonals so they are equal, so the frame is square. Nail the back panels on with nails H, using plates R at the panel joints; hold nails with clip K.
steps.tip: Nail straight into the middle of the board edge, not at an angle.

steps.title: Fix to the wall
steps.text: Push the wardrobe to the wall, mark and drill through the bracket slots, and fix with plugs and screws suitable for your wall (not included). Tighten bracket screws fully.
steps.tip: Buy wall plugs and screws that suit your wall type.
steps.warn: Must be fixed to the wall to stop it tipping over.

steps.title: Choose the interior layout
steps.text: Choose layout A (shelves right), B (shelves left) or C (shelves in the middle) and go to the matching page.

steps.title: Layout A: shelves and rails
steps.text: Fit 16 shelf pins J in the right compartment and lay the 4 shelves 7 on them. Screw 4 rail holders N with screws L under the top and drop the 2 clothes rails 24 into them (left and middle).
steps.tip: Put pins at the same height on both sides so shelves sit level.

steps.title: Layout B: shelves and rails
steps.text: Only for layout B: fit 16 shelf pins J and 4 shelves 7 in the left compartment, and the rails 24 with holders N and screws L in the middle and right.

steps.title: Layout C: shelves and rails
steps.text: Only for layout C: fit shelf pins J and shelves 7 in the middle and low in the sides, and the rails 24 with holders N and screws L in the left and right.

steps.title: Cam screws in drawer fronts
steps.text: Screw 4 cam screws F into the back of each drawer front 15 (12 in total).

steps.title: Dowels in drawer sides
steps.text: Tap 2 dowels into the back end of each drawer side 16L and 17R (12 in total).
steps.tip: Groove of each side must face inward and down.

steps.title: Join sides to fronts
steps.text: Put sides 16L and 17R onto each drawer front and lock with 2 cam locks E per side (12 in total).
steps.tip: 16L on the left, 17R on the right when looking at the front.

steps.title: Slide in drawer bottoms
steps.text: Slide a bottom 19 into the grooves of each drawer.
steps.tip: Bottom panel is 498 mm square; slide it in fully.

steps.title: Dowels in drawer backs
steps.text: Tap 4 dowels into each drawer back 18, 2 at each end (12 in total).

steps.title: Fit drawer backs
steps.text: Tilt the sides out slightly (about 5°), fit back 18 onto the dowels, and fix it with 1 connector screw D through each side (2 per drawer, 6 in total).
steps.tip: Lean the sides out only a little to avoid cracking the joints.

steps.title: Runners on drawers
steps.text: Screw a runner DL to the left side and DR to the right side of each drawer with 3 screws L each.
steps.tip: Runner wheel goes at the back of the drawer.

steps.title: Insert the drawers
steps.text: Set each drawer's runners on the cabinet runners, tilt and push it in until it runs smoothly.

steps.title: Hinges on middle door
steps.text: Press 3 hinges B into the cups of door 13 and screw each with 2 screws L.

steps.title: Hinges on tall doors
steps.text: Press 4 hinges B into each tall door 14 and screw each with 2 screws L.

steps.title: Hang the tall doors
steps.text: Clip and screw the tall doors to the left and right sides and adjust the hinge screws so the gaps are even.

steps.title: Choose middle door side
steps.text: Choose whether the middle door opens from the left (L) or right (R) and go to the matching page.

steps.title: Option L: hinge strip
steps.text: Only for left-hinged middle door: screw hinge strip 23 to divider 21L above shelf 8 with 5 screws M.
steps.tip: Use the hole pattern shown: 2 at top, 2 in the middle, 1 low.

steps.title: Option L: hang middle door
steps.text: Hang door 13 on hinge strip 23 and adjust the hinges.

steps.title: Option R: hinge strip
steps.text: Only for right-hinged middle door: screw hinge strip 23 to divider 3R with 5 screws M.

steps.title: Option R: hang middle door
steps.text: Hang door 13 on the right and adjust the hinges.

steps.title: Respect load limits
steps.text: Max load: top 40 kg, each clothes rail 11 kg, each shelf 10 kg, bottoms 20 kg, each drawer 5 kg.
